entries.jp: はい　お待たせ\n今日の昼定食は\nすぱげってぃーね
entries.en:
Here you go,
sorry to keep you
waiting. Today's
lunch special is
spaghetti.

entries.jp: うおおお　うまそうじゃ\nええ香りがしてたまらん\nこれは……細いうどん？
entries.en:
Whoa, that looks
tasty! Smells so
good I can't
stand it! Is this...
skinny udon?

entries.jp: うどんじゃなく　ぱすた\n伊太利亜の麺なの
entries.en: It's not udon,\ndear, it's pasta.\nItalian noodles.

entries.jp: おおおー　ぱすたー\nようわからんが\n美味そうじゃ
entries.en:
Ooooh, pasta!
No idea what
that is, but it
looks delicious!

entries.jp: お味のほうもバッチリよ\n温かいうちに食べてね
entries.en: It tastes just\nperfect, too. Eat\nit while it's warm.

entries.jp: おう　頂きます
entries.en: Yeah, thanks\nfor the food.

entries.jp: では頂きます
entries.en: Then, thank you\nfor the meal.

entries.jp: このぱすたは美味い！\n土佐のうどんも美味いが\n料理に幅がないからな
entries.en:
This pasta's
delicious! Tosa
udon's tasty too,
but there ain't
much variety in
the cookin'.

entries.jp: ぱすたには唐辛子が\n良く似合う　美味い！
entries.en: Chili peppers\ngo great with\npasta. Delicious!

entries.jp: 茹で方も味付けも\nすごく研究されていて\n美味しいですよね
entries.en:
The boiling and
the seasoning
have both been
carefully worked
out. It's
delicious, isn't it?

entries.jp: ふふふっ\nそう言ってくれると\n作りがいがあるわねえ
entries.en:
Hehe. Hearing
that makes
cooking worth
it, dear.

entries.jp: お登勢やん\nお代わり！
entries.en: Otose-yan!\nSeconds!

entries.jp: はいはい　龍ちゃんは\nよく食べるわねえ
entries.en: Coming, coming.\nMy, Ryo-chan,\nyou sure can eat.

entries.jp: オレ様もお代わりだ
entries.en: Yours truly will\nhave seconds too.

entries.jp: はいはい　晋ちゃんも\nよく食べるわねえ\n五郎ちゃん　お代わりは？
entries.en:
Coming, coming.
Shin-chan sure
can eat too.
Goro-chan, how
about seconds?

entries.jp: 私はゆっくり食べてるから\nあとでお代わりします
entries.en: I'm eating slowly,\nso I'll have\nseconds later.

entries.jp: ゆっくりと食べてると\nみんな食べられちゃうわよ
entries.en: If you eat slowly,\nthese boys will\neat it all up, dear.

entries.jp: 食事ぐらいは\nゆっくり食べないと\n消化に悪いですからね
entries.en:
At meals, at least,
one should eat
slowly. Otherwise
it's bad for the
digestion.

entries.jp: はあ～\n五郎ちゃんは食べ方が\n優雅でステキよね
entries.en:
Haah~ Goro-chan,
the way you eat
is so elegant. It's
lovely.

entries.jp: えっ　そうですか？
entries.en: Oh, is it?

entries.jp: いつ見ても上品な食べ方で\n感心してるのよ
entries.en:
You always have
such refined
manners. I'm
impressed every
time.

entries.jp: まあ　桂さんは家柄が\n良いしな\nオレ様とは違うんだよ
entries.en:
Well, Katsura-san
comes from a
good family. He's
not like yours
truly.

entries.jp: シンディらしくないな\n家柄うんぬんなんぞ\nロックじゃないじゃろ
entries.en:
That ain't like
you, Shindy.
All that talk
about family
background
ain't rock.

entries.jp: うるせえよ　龍馬は\nオレ様にはオレ様の\nロック論があるんだよ
entries.en:
Shut up, Ryoma.
Yours truly has
his own theory
of rock.

entries.jp: じゃあごゆっくり\n好きにお代わりしてね
entries.en:
Well, take your
time, boys. Have
as many seconds
as you like.

entries.jp: しかしまあ　センセーが\n良家のご子息ってのは\n合点がいくなぁ
entries.en:
Still, Sensei bein'
the son of a
good family sure
makes sense.

entries.jp: 躾が行き届いている点か？
entries.en: You mean how\nwell brought\nup he is?

entries.jp: お登勢やんの言う通り\n飯を食うのが上品じゃ\nけど料理は作れん
entries.en:
Like Otose-yan
says, he eats
real classy. But
he can't cook.

entries.jp: 魚を三枚に下ろすとか\n私は苦手ですからね\n晋作には敵わないよ
entries.en:
Filleting a fish
and the like is
not my strong
suit. I'm no match
for Shinsaku.

entries.jp: 藩医のせがれに生まれて\nばあやの上げ膳据え膳じゃ\n無理もねえだろ
entries.en:
Born the son of
a domain doctor,
with a nanny
waiting on him
hand and foot.
No wonder.

entries.jp: オレ様の家は飯の度に\n戦みたいなものだったし\n自炊も得意なわけだ
entries.en:
At my house,
every meal
was like a war,
so I got good
at cooking for
myself.

entries.jp: なるほど\n合点がいった！
entries.en: I see! Now it all\nmakes sense!

entries.jp: なにがだよ？
entries.en: What does?

entries.jp: シンディが\nがさつなところに\n合点がいった！
entries.en: Why you're so\nrough around the\nedges, Shindy!

entries.jp: ガサツが着物着て\n歩いているような\nおまえがいうな！
entries.en:
Don't say that,
you walking pile
of rough edges
in a kimono!

entries.jp: あいたーっ！\n叩かれたら鼻から\nぱすたが出たぜよ！
entries.en:
Owww! You
smacked me
and pasta came
out my nose!

entries.jp: 汚ぇなあ　まったく\nちっとは桂さんを見習って\n静かに食え
entries.en:
That's gross,
seriously. Learn
a thing or two
from Katsura-san
and eat quietly.

entries.jp: 晋作　騒がしいです\n食事時は静かにしましょう
entries.en:
Shinsaku, you're
being noisy.
Let's keep quiet
at mealtimes.

entries.jp: す　すまねえ
entries.en: S-sorry.

entries.jp: 食べ物に感謝する心は\nロックの心にも\n通じると思うんですよ
entries.en:
I believe a heart
that's grateful
for food connects
to the heart of
rock, too.

entries.jp: おお　さすがセンセーじゃ\n食べ物を粗末にするのは\nロックとはいえん！
entries.en:
Ooh, that's
Sensei for ya!
Wastin' food
ain't rock, no sir!

entries.jp: まあな　しかしそういう\n既成概念を覆す型破りも\nロックの内じゃねえのか？
entries.en:
Sure. But isn't
breaking the mold
and overturning
conventional
ideas like that
part of rock too?

entries.jp: 破天荒なロックは\nわしの望むところじゃ
entries.en: Wild, outrageous\nrock is just what\nI'm after!

entries.jp: 型破りと破天荒は別ですよ\nそれにどちらも基本的な\n心がしっかりしてないとね
entries.en:
Breaking the
mold and being
outrageous are
two different
things. And both
need a solid heart
at their core.

entries.jp: 人を敬う気持ちや\n感謝の心がなければ\n上辺だけの歌になるんです
entries.en:
Without respect
for others and a
grateful heart, a
song is nothing
but surface.

entries.jp: そんな歌では人の心に\n語りかけるなんて\n無理じゃないですか
entries.en:
A song like that
could never
speak to people's
hearts, could it?

entries.jp: ……正論過ぎて言葉がねえ
entries.en: ...That's so\nright I've got\nnothing to say.

entries.jp: そんな難しいことは考えて\nおらんかった……
entries.en: I never thought\nabout anything\nthat complicated...

entries.jp: 龍馬くんのロックは\n理屈じゃないですから
entries.en: Ryoma-kun's rock\nisn't about logic.

entries.jp: 深く考えないほうが\n良いんじゃないと\nそう思いますよ
entries.en: I think it's better\nif you don't think\ntoo hard about it.

entries.jp: バカの考え休むに似たり\nっつーしな
entries.en:
Like they say,
a fool thinking
is as good as a
fool napping.

entries.jp: あははは……\nひどいですね　晋作は
entries.en: Ahaha... That's\nmean of you,\nShinsaku.

entries.jp: ええ話が聞けた\nぱすたも美味いし\n最高の気分じゃ
entries.en:
I got to hear a
great talk, and
the pasta's
tasty too. I
feel fantastic!

entries.jp: それにしてもセンセーは\nお人がええところが\n本当に良家の出じゃな～
entries.en:
Still, the way
Sensei's such a
good-natured
fella really shows
he comes from a
good family~

entries.jp: まあな　桂さんは\n子供の頃から　お人好しの\nところがあるな
entries.en:
Yeah.
Katsura-san's
been a soft
touch ever since
he was a kid.

entries.jp: そうかな？　私は普通だと\n思っていますけど
entries.en: Am I? I think\nI'm perfectly\nordinary.

entries.jp: そう思ってるのは\nあんただけだ　桂さん
entries.en: You're the only\none who thinks\nso, Katsura-san.

entries.jp: 桂さんが立ち売りに\n騙された時のこと\n覚えてるか？
entries.en:
Katsura-san,
remember the
time you got
conned by a
street peddler?

entries.jp: あったね　そんなこと\nあの時はごめんなさい\n晋作に迷惑掛けてしまって
entries.en:
That did
happen. I'm
sorry about that
time, Shinsaku.
I caused you so
much trouble.

entries.jp: なにがあったんじゃ？
entries.en: What happened?

entries.jp: 私がまだ幼い頃の話だけど\n立ち売りの行商人から\nお菓子を買ったんですよ
entries.en:
This was back
when I was still
little. I bought
some sweets from
a street peddler.

entries.jp: 晋作と一緒に食べようと\n思って買ったんですけどね\nそれで騙されてしまって
entries.en:
I bought them
thinking I'd
share them
with Shinsaku.
And that's how
I was tricked.

entries.jp: どう騙されたんじゃ？
entries.en: Tricked how?

entries.jp: 珍しいカスティラって菓子\nだというのがインチキでな
entries.en:
He said they
were a rare sweet
called castella,
but it was a scam.

entries.jp: 木の端切れに色を塗った\nだけだったんだ
entries.en:
They were
just scraps of
wood with
paint on them.

entries.jp: なんじゃと！\nそれはひどい\n行商人だなっ！
entries.en: What!? What a\nrotten peddler!

entries.jp: 楽しみにしてたから\nガッカリしちゃってね
entries.en:
I'd been so
looking forward
to them, so I
was very
disappointed.

entries.jp: 勉学は優秀でも　桂さんは\nどこかボケッとしてるから\n悪い野郎に騙されたんだ
entries.en:
Katsura-san
might be great
at his studies,
but he's kind
of spacey, so a
crook took him
for a ride.

entries.jp: 珍しくて嬉しいなとしか\n考えてなかったですからー
entries.en:
All I could
think was how
happy I was to
get something
so rare.

entries.jp: 金取られてニセモノとは\nそりゃガッカリぜよ
entries.en:
Payin' good
money and gettin'
a fake? That's a
real letdown.

entries.jp: 騙された私が悪いし\n勉強代だって言ったら\n晋作が激昂してね
entries.en:
I said it was my
own fault for
being tricked
and that I'd paid
for a lesson,
and Shinsaku
flew into a rage.

entries.jp: 当たり前だろうが\n泣き寝入りするなんて\nロックじゃねえからな
entries.en: Obviously!\nTaking it lying\ndown isn't rock.

entries.jp: 晋作はすごい剣幕で\n薪を片手に行商人を\n追っていったんですよ
entries.en:
Shinsaku went
chasing after
the peddler,
furious, with a
stick of firewood
in his hand.

entries.jp: ほう　シンディは\n熱い男だから\n納得がゆくな
entries.en: Ho! Shindy's a\nhot-blooded guy,\nso that figures.

entries.jp: そんなんじゃねえよ\n幼い子供を騙すなんざ\n許されねえからな
entries.en:
It's not like
that. Cheating a
little kid is just
unforgivable.

entries.jp: シンディは悪い行商人を\n薪でボコボコにこらしめた\nというオチじゃな！
entries.en:
And the
punchline is,
Shindy beat
that crooked
peddler black
and blue with
the firewood!

entries.jp: ま　まあな
entries.en: W-well, yeah.

entries.jp: あれ？\n成敗せんかったのか？
entries.en: Huh? Ya\ndidn't give\nhim what for?

entries.jp: 返り討ちにされて\nボコボコになって\n帰って来たんですよね
entries.en:
The peddler
fought back,
and he came
home black and
blue himself,
didn't he?

entries.jp: か　桂さんっ\nばらしてんじゃねえよ！
entries.en: K-Katsura-san!\nDon't go\nspilling that!

entries.jp: たんこぶと傷だらけで\nそれでも手にはしっかり\n代金を握りしめててね
entries.en:
He was covered
in lumps and
scrapes, but he
still had the
money clutched
tight in his hand.

entries.jp: 気を付けろよ\n世の中には悪い大人が\nたくさんいるからなって
entries.en:
"Be careful.
There are lots of
bad grown-ups
in this world,"
he told me.

entries.jp: それは思い出さなくても\nいい話だぜ　桂さんよ
entries.en:
That's a story
you don't need
to remember,
Katsura-san.

entries.jp: コロッと騙されるような\nお人好しだってことを\n思い出せっつってんだ
entries.en:
What I'm telling
you to remember
is that you're such
a softie you'll fall
for anything.

entries.jp: まさに男の中の男！\nシンディは真の男じゃ\nわしは感激したっ！
entries.en:
A man among
men! Shindy,
you're the real
deal! I'm
downright
moved, I tell ya!

entries.jp: 晋作は子供の頃から\nとても正義感が強い男でね\n私はよく助けられたのです
entries.en:
Shinsaku has had
a strong sense of
justice ever since
he was a child.
He came to my
rescue many
times.

entries.jp: うんうん　ええ男じゃな\nシンディ！
entries.en: Yep, yep, what\na fine fella you\nare, Shindy!

entries.jp: やめろ　龍馬\n肩を叩くな\n飯がまずくなる
entries.en:
Knock it off,
Ryoma. Quit
slapping my
shoulder.
You're ruining
my appetite.

entries.jp: あははっ　晋作\n照れてるんですか
entries.en: Ahaha, Shinsaku,\nare you\nembarrassed?

entries.jp: オレ様が桂さんを\n助けたのは　別の意味も\nあったけどな
entries.en:
Mind you, yours
truly had
another reason
for helping you
out, Katsura-san.

entries.jp: あ……もうやめましょう\nこの話は　ね？
entries.en: Ah... Let's stop\ntalking about this\nnow, shall we?

entries.jp: オレ様の話ばかりじゃ\n龍馬もつまらねえだろ
entries.en:
Nothing but
stories about the
great Takasugi
must be boring
for Ryoma, too.

entries.jp: もっといろいろな\n話を聞きたいぜよ
entries.en: I wanna hear\nall sorts of\nstories, I tell ya!

entries.jp: 今の桂さんは大人しいけど\n元々はクソが付くほど\n悪ガキだったんだぜ
entries.en:
Katsura-san's all
mild-mannered
now, but he used
to be a damn
rotten little brat.

entries.jp: ほうほう　そりゃすぐには\n信じられん話じゃ
entries.en:
Well, well, now
that's a tough
one to swallow
right off the bat.

entries.jp: 船から荷を運ぶ小舟を\n揺すってひっくり返したり\nしてたもんだ
entries.en:
He used to rock
the little boats
that carried cargo
off the ships until
they flipped over.

entries.jp: あはは……なぜ\n浮かぶのか不思議だった\nんですよ
entries.en:
Ahaha... I
wondered why
they floated,
you see.

entries.jp: 好奇心が強くて　\nなんでも試してみないと\n気が済まなくてなぁ
entries.en:
He was so curious
he couldn't rest
until he'd tried
everything
himself.

entries.jp: 次から次へと　\n何かしでかすんだ
entries.en:
He was always
getting up to
one thing
after another.

entries.jp: なんか　センセー\nらしいぜよ
entries.en: Sounds just like\nSensei, I reckon.

entries.jp: それで痛い目を見る\nこともあるからな\nなあ　桂さん
entries.en:
And sometimes
that gets you
hurt. Right,
Katsura-san?

entries.jp: そうですね\n小舟をひっくり返した時に\n殴られて骨身に染みました
entries.en:
Indeed. When
I flipped that
boat over, I
took a beating
that taught me
a lesson down
to the bone.

entries.jp: おおっ\n怪我でもしたか？
entries.en: Whoa! Did\nya get hurt?

entries.jp: おでこが切れてしまってね\n父に怪我の理由を聞かれて\n答えられなくてね……
entries.en:
I cut my
forehead. When
my father asked
how I'd been
hurt, I couldn't
answer him...

entries.jp: そしたら晋作が家に来て\nケンカして怪我させました\nごめんなさいって
entries.en:
Then Shinsaku
came to our
house and said,
"We got in a
fight and I hurt
him. I'm sorry."

entries.jp: ええっ \nそんなことあったか？
entries.en: Huh? Did\nthat happen?

entries.jp: 晋作は　忘れたんですか？\n私を庇ってくれたんですよ
entries.en: Shinsaku, you\nforgot? You\ncovered for me.

entries.jp: ああ　すっかり忘れてた
entries.en: Yeah, it\ncompletely\nslipped my mind.

entries.jp: それがあって私は\n悪さをしなくなったのに
entries.en:
That was what
made me give
up mischief, and
you don't even
remember...

entries.jp: はあ……\n余計な話で蒸し返すんじゃ\nなかったな
entries.en:
Sigh... I
shouldn't have
gone dredging
up old stories.

entries.jp: シンディは　わしには\nちょっぴり冷たいけど\n本当に　ええ男じゃあ！
entries.en:
Shindy's a tad
cold to me, but
he really is
one fine fella!

entries.jp: おまえみたいな\nバカの相手をするのは\n疲れるからな
entries.en:
That's 'cause
dealing with an
idiot like you
wears me out.

entries.jp: はあ　それは厳しいのう\n気苦労が絶えんなあ\nシンディ
entries.en:
Aw, that's rough.
Your worries
never end, do
they, Shindy?

entries.jp: だからおまえが言うな！
entries.en: Like I said, you're\nthe last one who\ngets to say that!

entries.jp: 晋作は昔から\n人の面倒を見るのが\n好きでしたから
entries.en:
Shinsaku
has always
liked looking
after people.

entries.jp: 天然過ぎて危なっかしくて\n見てられないからだろうが\n桂さんの場合はっ！
entries.en:
In your case it's
'cause you're such
a natural-born
airhead I can't
stand to watch,
Katsura-san!

entries.jp: 自ら面倒事に立ち向かう\n男の中の男！\nこれこそロックじゃ！
entries.en:
A man among
men who takes
on trouble all
by himself! Now
THAT'S rock!

entries.jp: ……そうかよ
entries.en: ...Is that so.

entries.jp: お代わり……って\nぱすたがねえな
entries.en: Seconds... Huh?\nThe pasta's gone.

entries.jp: 龍馬くんがぱすた全部\n食べちゃったみたいです
entries.en: It looks like\nRyoma-kun ate\nall the pasta.

entries.jp: いつの間に……
entries.en: When did he...?

entries.jp: うはははは\nやっと腹八分になった
entries.en:
Wahahaha!
My belly's
finally eighty
percent full!

entries.jp: あんだけ食って\n八分目かよ……
entries.en: You ate all that\nand you're only at\neighty percent...?

entries.jp: 健康の為に飯は控えめに\nするんじゃ
entries.en: Gotta keep meals\nmodest for your\nhealth, y'see.

entries.jp: 健康に気遣うとか\nロックじゃねえだろ……
entries.en: Watching your\nhealth? That ain't\nexactly rock...

entries.jp: それは違うぜよ　シンディ\n健全なロックは\n健全な体と魂に宿るんじゃ
entries.en:
That's where
you're wrong,
Shindy. Healthy
rock lives in a
healthy body and
a healthy soul!

entries.jp: あのなあ\n食うだけ食っといて\n偉そうに言うなっ！
entries.en:
Listen, you!
Don't act all
high and mighty
after stuffing
your face!

entries.jp: だーかーら！\n食事は静かにしましょう\n晋作　龍馬くん
entries.en:
Like I SAID!
Let's eat quietly,
Shinsaku,
Ryoma-kun.

entries.jp: すみません……
entries.en: Sorry...

entries.jp: 穏やかに憤慨する桂に\n高杉と龍馬は小さくなって\nしまったのだった
entries.en:
Before Katsura's
mild-mannered
fury, Takasugi
and Ryoma could
only shrink into
their seats.
